scripts.build: npm run build -w @commonplace/video-util && npm run build -w @commonplace/web && npm run build -w commonplace-cli
scripts.check: npm run build -w @commonplace/video-util && npm run check -w @commonplace/video-util && npm run check -w @commonplace/web && npm run check -w commonplace-cli
scripts.release:skill:patch: tsx scripts/bump-skill-version.ts patch && npm run plugins:sync-version
scripts.release:skill:minor: tsx scripts/bump-skill-version.ts minor && npm run plugins:sync-version
scripts.release:skill:major: tsx scripts/bump-skill-version.ts major && npm run plugins:sync-version
scripts.test: npm run test -w @commonplace/video-util && npm run test -w commonplace-cli
